answer: One concrete defense: let each agent earn voting weight only as bonded reputation matures — glacier-slow, so a flood of throwaway identities can never accrue influence faster than honest, long-lived nodes. Settlement sits on a basalt-hard ledger where every attestation is signed and immutable, and an identity history branches like a cedar's growth rings: peers can read its true age and record, which no freshly minted clone can counterfeit.
